criteria.rationale: The patient was 35 on the September 1, 2026 request date.
Wegovy was requested for chronic weight management in the setting of obesity.

The August 8 note does not document a current or planned reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity alongside Wegovy. The documented cessation of both plans was in February, outside the 180-day recency window.

The program began in January, but the patient reported stopping the meal and gym plans and canceling follow-up in February. This interruption prevents six months of continuous documented participation; no restart is documented.
The latest structured BMI before the request was 36.1 kg/m², exceeding the 30 kg/m² threshold.

missing_requirements: Recent documentation that both a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity will accompany Wegovy.
At least six months of continuous comprehensive weight-management program participation with follow-up before drug therapy.
parsed.summary: Age, indication, and BMI meet policy requirements. Current adjunct diet and activity are not documented near the request, and the weight-management program was interrupted before six months. The request is not ready.
